target_reference_entry: Chuyu Wang, Lei Xie, Yuancan Lin, Wei Wang, Yingying Chen, Yanling Bu, Kai Zhang, and Sanglu Lu. 2021. Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via RFID by capturing sub-mm level vibration. In Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies, Vol. 5. 1–25.
paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文将目标论文归类为利用RFID感知声学振动的现有侧信道窃听工作，在相关工作部分提及，未对其亚毫米级精度或首次开创性做出明确确认。

evidences.evidence_quote: Researchers use various sensors, such as accelerator [4, 32], gyroscope [40], Wi-Fi [57], mmWave [5, 30, 31, 55], and RFID [12, 37, 56] to capture speaker/microphone vibration or nearby surface vibration patterns for eavesdropping on speaker-produced or/and human-speaking sound.
evidences.evidence_context: Existing side-channel sound eavesdropping methods mainly sense sound-induced vibration (e.g., speaker/microphone vibration, nearby surface vibration, etc.) for sound content recovery. Researchers use various sensors, such as accelerator [4, 32], gyroscope [40], Wi-Fi [57], mmWave [5, 30, 31, 55], and RFID [12, 37, 56] to capture speaker/microphone vibration or nearby surface vibration patterns for eavesdropping on speaker-produced or/and human-speaking sound.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用论文仅在相关工作段落中简单列举RFID窃听工作，其中包含目标论文，但未对目标论文的具体贡献（如亚毫米级振动感知）做出明确陈述或正面肯定。该引用属于普通的文献综述，不构成对亚毫米级能力或首次开创性的确认。
